description_en: Creates a user in a specified workspace. The username must be unique within the workspace and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Reserved names such as manager, admin, or names starting with worker- cannot be used. If password is not specified, the server generates an initial password and returns it in the initialPassword field of the response
description_zh: 在指定工作空间内创建用户。用户名称在工作空间内唯一，只能包含小写字母、数字和连字符，并且不能使用 manager、admin 或以 worker- 开头的保留名称。不指定 password 时由服务端生成初始密码，并通过响应中的 initialPassword 返回
name: CreateUser

fields.help_en: The display name of the user. The display name must be 1 to 32 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 用户显示名称，长度为 1~32 个字符
fields.name: display_name

fields.help_en: The email address of the user. The email address can be up to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 用户邮箱地址，长度不超过 256 个字符
fields.name: email

fields.help_en: The username. The username must be unique within the workspace and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. It must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit and be 1 to 32 characters in length. Reserved names such as manager, admin, or names starting with worker- cannot be used
fields.help_zh: 用户名称。在工作空间内唯一，只能包含小写字母、数字和连字符，必须以小写字母或数字开头和结尾，长度为 1~32 个字符。不能使用 manager、admin 或以 worker- 开头的保留名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The remarks of the user. The remarks can be up to 1024 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 用户备注，长度不超过 1024 个字符
fields.name: note

fields.help_en: The initial password of the user. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The password cannot contain the username. If this parameter is not specified, the server generates a random password and returns it in the initialPassword field of the response
fields.help_zh: 用户初始密码，长度为 8~32 个字符，必须同时包含大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符，并且不能包含用户名称。不指定该参数时由服务端生成随机密码，并通过响应中的 initialPassword 返回
fields.name: password

parameters.help_en: The request body for creating a user
parameters.name: body

data.description_en: The information about the created user

authMethod.description_en: The authentication method of the user. A value of password indicates local password authentication within the workspace. Values of dingtalk and feishu indicate that the user is synchronized and authenticated by the corresponding external identity provider
authMethod.description_zh: 用户的认证方式。password 表示使用工作空间本地密码认证，dingtalk 和 feishu 表示由对应的外部身份提供商同步并认证

createdAt.description_en: The time when the user was created, in UTC and RFC 3339 format
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

displayName.description_en: The display name of the user. The display name must be 1 to 32 characters in length
displayName.description_zh: 用户显示名称，长度为 1~32 个字符

email.description_en: The email address of the user. The email address can be up to 256 characters in length
email.description_zh: 用户邮箱地址，长度不超过 256 个字符

initialPassword.description_en: The initial password of the user. If password was specified during creation, the specified password is returned. If password was not specified, a random password generated by the server is returned
initialPassword.description_zh: 用户的初始密码。创建时指定了 password 则返回该密码，未指定时返回服务端生成的随机密码

name.description_en: The username. The username is unique within the workspace and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. It must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit and be 1 to 32 characters in length
name.description_zh: 用户名称。在工作空间内唯一，只能包含小写字母、数字和连字符，必须以小写字母或数字开头和结尾，长度为 1~32 个字符

note.description_en: The remarks of the user. The remarks can be up to 1024 characters in length
note.description_zh: 用户备注，长度不超过 1024 个字符

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the resource

status.description_en: The user status. Valid values: Creating, Active, Updating, Deleting, Failed, and DeleteFailed

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the user was last modified, in UTC and RFC 3339 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
